name: Baldi Frenzy [ALPHA]
desc:
The game will stay in ALPHA state forever, we ended up discontinuing this project for sake of our health. Thanks everyone for playing!

Welcome to Baldi Frenzy!
Step into a wild game of hide and seek with Baldi, featuring unique game style, special rounds, and multiple modifiers!
Make a custom avatar, find clever hiding spots, and experience endless fun!

Hardcore Servers Reward 2x More YTPs!
You can check out the game controls in the lobby, as well the game rules!
